stemMd: A route visits X, Y and Z once each after leaving a depot. X must be visited before Z. How many visit orders are possible?
explanationMd: The six permutations split equally between X before Z and Z before X. Explicitly the valid orders are XYZ, XZY and YXZ. Thus there are three.

distractorRationale.b: This omits one valid position for Y.
distractorRationale.d: Only half the six permutations satisfy the ordering.
distractorRationale.e: This counts orders with Z before X as well.
distractorRationale.a: Y has more than one possible position.
